<function name="OnOtherKilled" parent="NEXTBOT" type="hook">
	<description>Called when someone else or something else has been killed.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="victim" type="Entity">The victim that was killed</arg>
		<arg name="info" type="CTakeDamageInfo">The damage info</arg>
	</args>
</function>
